name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
summary: A cat-proud, dog-sized red dragon hatchling with the ego of an emperor and a furnace for lungs; it already sleeps on a pile of stolen coins and bites anyone who tries to count them.
tactics: Opens with a cone of fire from the air, then darts in to bite whoever screams loudest; flees to its parent's lair when badly hurt, which is how most adventurers meet the parent.
habitat: volcanic caves and scorched hilltops
weakness: Vain and greedy; flattery or a bribe of gold buys a round of hesitation.

name: Young Rime Dragon
summary: A white-scaled hunter of the glaciers, more beast than sage, that buries its kills in the ice to eat later, and sometimes forgets which frozen body was still breathing.
tactics: Waits beneath a snowdrift, bursts out to breathe freezing mist that roots foes in place, then picks off the slowest one at a time.
habitat: glaciers, frozen peaks and ice caves
weakness: Dim-witted; easily lured into traps or baited with fresh meat.

alternates.name: Freezing Mist
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen solid)

name: Adult Storm Dragon
summary: A sapphire tyrant of the deep desert that lies buried in the dunes with only its great horn showing, waiting for caravans to wander into the lightning rod of its malice.
tactics: Erupts from the sand with a line of lightning down the caravan, then takes to the air and shatters formations with thunderclaps before swooping on stragglers.
habitat: deep deserts and storm-lashed badlands
weakness: Arrogant and territorial; it will abandon a winning fight to chase anyone who insults it.

alternates.name: Thunderclap
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened and reeling)

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Extended Vision, Detect Electricity

name: Adult Bog Dragon
summary: An inky, horned ambusher that lies submerged in black swamp water for days; its acid-dripping skull is mistaken for a rotting log until the log opens its eyes.
tactics: Smothers the area in clinging magical darkness, then spits a line of acid at anything carrying a light, and drags the blind into deep water.
habitat: black swamps, sunken ruins and flooded catacombs
weakness: Cowardly at heart; it abandons any fight that goes against it and can be bargained with by the clearly stronger.

name: Verdant Venom Dragon
summary: A schemer of ancient forests that prefers to talk its prey into the trap first; its breath is a green fog that makes lungs bubble and makes treaties sound very reasonable.
tactics: Negotiates from hiding, lies about everything, and breathes choking gas the moment the heroes relax; it would rather enslave than kill.
habitat: old-growth forests and overgrown elven ruins
weakness: Can't resist a clever lie or a secret; it will stop fighting to hear one out.

alternates.name: Choking Fog
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (choking)

name: Elder Shadow Dragon
summary: A dragon that flew too long in the lightless places between worlds; its scales drink torchlight, and its breath leaves victims as pale, hollow silhouettes of themselves.
tactics: Slides from shadow to shadow, unseen until it breathes; it drains the strongest hero first and melts into living darkness when cornered.
habitat: the Shadowfell borderlands, lightless chasms and ruined cathedrals
weakness: Bright magical light (daylight spells, sunblades) strips away its shadow form and stealth.

alternates.name: Soul-Dimming Breath
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

flaws.name: Limited
flaws.detail: only in darkness or dim light

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Extended Vision, Detect Life (ranged)

name: Crimson Great Wyrm
summary: Older than the mountain it hollowed out for a lair, this furnace-hearted tyrant has burned three empires to ash and still keeps an itemized ledger of every coin in its hoard, which it can feel being touched from a mile away.
tactics: Never fights fair: it melts the ground under armies, walks among mortals in human guise to spy, and ends every battle with a breath that cracks stone.
habitat: a hollowed-out volcano heaped with three empires of gold
weakness: Its hoard is its heart; threaten the hoard and it abandons all strategy in a blind rage.

alternates.name: Wall of Living Flame
alternates.detail: Walls and domes of white-hot fire

powers.name: Frightful Presence
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (cowering in terror)

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Extended Vision, Detect Gold (ranged, acute)

name: Gold Dragon Sage
summary: A radiant philosopher-wyrm that has spent a thousand years disguised as a blind beggar, testing which kingdoms deserve to survive; its breath can melt a castle gate or simply leave an army too weak to lift its swords.
tactics: Prefers to talk and to test; when forced to fight it weakens rather than kills, and only strikes to kill against true and unrepentant evil.
habitat: mountain monasteries, hidden lakes and royal courts (in disguise)
weakness: Bound by honor; it keeps its word even to enemies and will not harm innocents to win.

alternates.name: Weakening Breath
alternates.detail: Strength; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Darkvision, Scent, Extended Vision, Detect Evil (ranged)

name: Silver Dragon Knight-Errant
summary: A silver dragon who walks among mortals as a wandering knight, sworn to an order that has long forgotten its founder had wings; it stands on clouds as if they were marble.
tactics: Fights beside mortal allies in human form until things turn grim, then sheds the disguise and paralyzes enemies with breath before tearing into their champions.
habitat: cloud-wrapped peaks and the halls of knightly orders
weakness: Protective to a fault; threatening innocents will pull it out of any position.

alternates.name: Paralyzing Breath
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed

powers.name: Cloud Walking
powers.detail: Stand and walk on clouds and fog as if solid ground

name: Wyvern
summary: A two-legged drake with a scorpion's sting on a whip of a tail; too stupid to speak, too mean to tame, and favored by orc warlords who fly them anyway.
tactics: Swoops, stings, and climbs out of reach, letting the venom work before diving again on whatever has fallen.
habitat: crags, sea cliffs and orc aeries
weakness: Clumsy on the ground; a grounded wyvern is a slow, easily flanked target.

powers.name: Venom Stinger
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated (poisoned)

name: Fire Drake
summary: A wingless, wolf-sized lizard with an ember-glowing throat that hunts in yapping packs through the volcanic badlands; dwarves breed them as fire-spitting guard hounds.
tactics: Packs spread out and spit fire from several angles before rushing in to bite whoever is burning.
habitat: lava fields, dwarven forges and hot springs
weakness: Water douses its throat-fire for several rounds.

name: Dragon Turtle
summary: A reef-sized dragon with a shell crusted in shipwrecks and barnacles; it demands a toll of treasure from every ship that crosses its waters, and those who refuse are boiled alive in steam.
tactics: Surfaces under a ship, capsizes it with a whirlpool, then boils the swimmers with steam and plucks the cargo from the wreck.
habitat: warm seas, reefs and shipping lanes
weakness: Slow to turn and greedy; a generous toll paid in full buys safe passage.

alternates.name: Whirlpool
alternates.detail: Only to drag ships and swimmers under

name: Teacup Drake
summary: A housecat-sized dragon with chameleon scales and a sleep-venom tail, famous for adopting wizards rather than the other way round; it purrs telepathically.
tactics: Stays invisible against walls, stings the most threatening intruder to sleep, then flees and telepathically alerts its chosen companion.
habitat: wizards' towers, libraries and warm hearths
weakness: Fragile and easily bribed with honey or cream.

powers.name: Sleep Sting
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Fatigued, Exhausted, Asleep

name: Goblin Cutthroat
summary: A knee-high sneak with a rusty blade and a grudge against anyone taller, which is everyone; goblins attack in giggling mobs from the dark and run the moment the odds even out.
tactics: Shoots from cover, swarms the isolated, and flees screaming when a third of the mob falls.
habitat: warrens, ruined keeps and dark forests
weakness: Cowardly; killing the leader or a show of force routs the mob.

name: Goblin Shaman
summary: A goblin draped in rat skulls and stolen curtains who hears the 'voices of the Below' and turns them into hexes; kill it first or the whole warband gets brave.
tactics: Hangs back behind the mob, mud-curses whoever charges, and blinds archers with witchfire.
habitat: goblin warrens and fungus caves
weakness: Frail; the warband panics if it falls.

alternates.name: Mudfoot Curse
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered, Immobile

alternates.name: Witchfire Glare
alternates.detail: Visual

name: Hobgoblin Warlord
summary: A disciplined tyrant in lacquered plate who runs a goblin horde like an imperial legion: drilled, branded, and decimated if they break ranks.
tactics: Never fights alone; directs volleys, sets up flanks for its troops, and closes only to finish a wounded hero.
habitat: fortified war-camps and conquered border keeps
weakness: Rigid; an unexpected tactic or a broken chain of command throws its troops into confusion.

name: Orc Berserker
summary: A scar-plated reaver who chews war-mushrooms before battle and keeps swinging after it should be dead; berserkers go in first because the warchief cannot stop them anyway.
tactics: Charges the biggest target, all-out attacks every round, and never retreats.
habitat: orc war-camps and blasted badlands
weakness: Reckless; easily baited into traps, pits or friendly fire.

name: Orc Warchief
summary: A towering orc in a crown of enemy jawbones who earned his rank by beating the last warchief to death with the last warchief's own shield; his war-cry turns a mob into a stampede.
tactics: Leads from the front, roars to rally his warband, and challenges the strongest enemy to single combat for the sake of his legend.
habitat: war-camps, raided villages and stolen fortresses
weakness: Pride; he must accept any public challenge, and his warband scatters if he is humiliated.

name: Kobold Trapper
summary: A yapping, dog-faced little reptile who can't win a fair fight and never tries to; its tunnels are a maze of tripwires, swinging logs, and pits full of very angry centipedes.
tactics: Lures foes down trapped corridors, slings stones from murder-holes, and collapses the tunnel behind itself.
habitat: mines, dragon lairs and twisting tunnels
weakness: Terrified of dragons and anything that looks like one.

name: Gnoll Reaver
summary: A hyena-headed raider that laughs while it kills and eats the slowest of its own pack in lean winters; gnolls follow the smell of blood across three valleys.
tactics: Runs prey down in packs, harries with arrows, and gangs up on anything bleeding.
habitat: savannah, scrubland and raided frontier towns
weakness: Frenzies at the smell of blood and can be lured off by a fresh carcass.

name: Lizardfolk Hunter
summary: A cold-blooded marsh hunter who regards outsiders with neither hate nor pity, only appetite; it will happily share a feast and then explain that you were the feast.
tactics: Strikes from the water with javelins, drags the wounded under, and holds its breath while they drown.
habitat: swamps, mangroves and sunken temples
weakness: Sluggish in cold; fighting it in frost or snow hinders it.

name: Bugbear Skulker
summary: A shaggy seven-foot goblin cousin that moves as silently as snowfall despite its bulk, drags victims into the dark by the ankle, and trades their boots to goblins for ale.
tactics: Ambushes from above or behind, hits hard with a morningstar, and hauls the stunned victim away into the dark.
habitat: goblin warrens, dark woods and abandoned mines
weakness: Lazy and greedy; it will drop a fight to steal unattended loot.

name: Dark Elf Blade-Dancer
summary: A silver-haired duelist of the sunless cities who fights in a whirling trance-dance taught in temples where a misstep means death; her blades sing a different note for every kill.
tactics: Drops magical darkness on the enemy line, then dances through it, feinting and cutting, never staying in one place.
habitat: underground cities and moonless forests
weakness: Sunlight blinds and disorients her.

name: Dark Elf High Priestess
summary: A high priestess of the Web Below whose sermons are delivered with a scourge of living vipers; she can make a man kneel with a word, and she wraps disobedient novices in silk for the temple spiders.
tactics: Dominates the strongest hero to fight his friends, webs the rest, and summons spiders to finish them while she watches from a wall.
habitat: spider-temples in underground cities
weakness: Ruthless rivals; turning her own priestesses against her is easier than it should be.

alternates.name: Call the Brood
alternates.detail: Giant spiders

alternates.name: Unholy Darkness
alternates.detail: All visual senses

name: Dwarf Runeshield Guardian
summary: A clan champion sealed into plate etched with ancestor-runes that glow brighter the more blood is spilled; he has held one doorway for ninety years and does not intend to step aside now.
tactics: Plants himself in a chokepoint, shrugs off spells with his ward-runes, and takes the hit for any ally beside him.
habitat: dwarven halls, mountain gates and ancestral tombs
weakness: Will not abandon his post, even to chase a fleeing foe.

name: Hill Giant
summary: Twenty feet of slack-jawed hunger with a tree for a club; a hill giant raids farms for cattle, ale and anyone who looks crunchy, and can be talked out of almost anything by someone holding a ham.
tactics: Hurls boulders from a distance, then wades in swinging; it always goes for whoever looks most edible.
habitat: rolling hills and raided farmland
weakness: Gullible and easily distracted by food or shiny trinkets.

name: Frost Giant Jarl
summary: A blue-skinned jarl of the glaciers who drinks from the frozen skulls of rival chieftains and rides to war on a sled pulled by mammoths; winter itself seems to follow him.
tactics: Calls a blizzard to blind his foes, then cleaves through them with a greataxe of black ice.
habitat: glaciers, frozen fjords and ice-halls
weakness: Fire hurts him; also bound by oaths of hospitality to anyone who shares his mead.

name: Fire Giant Forgemaster
summary: A soot-black, flame-bearded warrior-smith who forges cursed blades in the heart of a volcano and tests each one on a prisoner; fire giant armies march in lockstep, chanting the hammer-songs of their forge.
tactics: Opens by hurling molten rock, then advances in heavy plate; anyone who strikes him bare-handed is burned by his forge-heat.
habitat: volcano-forges and obsidian fortresses
weakness: Cold and water hurt him badly, and he cannot resist examining a masterwork weapon.

name: Storm Giant Oracle
summary: A sea-green titan who dwells in a palace at the bottom of the ocean and reads the future in lightning; when a storm giant draws its sword, the sky draws with it.
tactics: Calls down thunderbolts from the clouds, scatters armies with hurricane gusts, and closes with its stormblade only against a worthy foe.
habitat: undersea palaces and storm-wrapped mountain peaks
weakness: Fatalistic; it can be swayed by a prophecy it believes in.

alternates.name: Thunderclap
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened)

powers.name: Keen Senses
powers.detail: Extended Vision, Darkvision, Precognition (omens in lightning)

name: Ogre
summary: A ten-foot glutton with a spiked club and a sack of 'snacks' that are still kicking; ogres hire out as muscle to anyone who pays in meat.
tactics: Smashes whatever is closest, grabs a smaller foe to use as a shield or snack, and flees if it loses its club.
habitat: caves, ruined towers and the bottom of the employment ladder
weakness: Stupid; tricks, flattery and simple riddles confuse it.

name: Ettin
summary: A two-headed giant whose heads despise each other (one wants to eat you now, the other later), but in a fight they agree on everything, swinging two flails with frightening coordination.
tactics: One head watches the flanks while the other picks a target; it attacks twice a round and is almost never caught off guard.
habitat: barren hills and mountain caves
weakness: Turning the heads against each other with a well-placed insult can make it fumble.

name: Cave Troll
summary: A lumpy, gray-hided brute from the deep roots of the mountain whose skin is half granite; it regenerates from almost any wound, but a single shaft of true sunlight freezes it into a statue forever.
tactics: Grabs, crushes and keeps fighting through wounds that should kill it; it retreats only from daylight.
habitat: deep caverns and mountain roots
weakness: Direct sunlight turns it to stone; fire and acid stop its regeneration.

name: Bridge Troll
summary: A moss-covered, river-smelling troll who lives under a bridge and demands a toll in riddles, songs or goats; it is absolutely bound by its own rules, which it remembers far better than anyone trying to cheat it.
tactics: Grabs anyone crossing without paying and dunks them in the river until they agree to the toll.
habitat: under old stone bridges and river fords
weakness: Bound by its own bargains; win the riddle game and it must let you pass.

name: Pixie Swarm
summary: A giggling cloud of thumb-sized fey with dragonfly wings, swarming like gnats with pinprick spears and dust that makes grown warriors dance until they drop asleep in the mud.
tactics: Wink out of sight, sprinkle dust to put the party to sleep, then steal boots, rings and ration packs.
habitat: flower meadows, fairy rings and moonlit glades
weakness: Cold iron and sweet things: a pocket of sugar or honey distracts the whole swarm.

powers.name: Pixie Dust
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Asleep

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: A cloud of tiny fey; pours through gaps and shrugs off single blows

name: Dryad
summary: A green-haired spirit bound to a single ancient oak, as lovely as spring and as jealous as winter; she lures woodcutters into her grove with a smile and never lets them leave.
tactics: Charms the strongest intruder to defend her, roots the others in place, and steps from tree to tree out of reach.
habitat: ancient groves and sacred oaks
weakness: Bound to her tree; threaten the oak and she will bargain, fell it and she dies.

powers.name: Heartwood Charm
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Thornmother Hag
summary: A crone with iron teeth and a necklace of children's milk-teeth who trades in bargains, curses and stolen names; she has hidden her heart in a jar somewhere in the swamp, and until it is found she always comes back.
tactics: Appears as a kindly old woman, strikes a bargain, then curses whoever breaks it, withering the strong and turning the clever into toads.
habitat: witch-huts in fen and forest, often on chicken legs
weakness: Her hidden heart-jar is her life; and she must honor any bargain fairly struck.

alternates.name: Turn to Toad
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Disabled, Transformed (toad)

powers.name: Fair Maiden Guise
powers.detail: A lovely maiden or a harmless grandmother

name: Redcap
summary: A wizened little fey murderer in iron-shod boots who must dip his cap in fresh blood every day or die; redcaps haunt ruined border towers and grin with teeth like broken glass.
tactics: Sprints in on clanking iron boots, hacks with an oversized scythe, and soaks his cap in the blood of the fallen to heal.
habitat: ruined towers and old battlefields
weakness: Holy symbols or scripture read aloud make him flee; and he must stop to dip his cap.

name: Will-o'-Wisp
summary: A drifting ghost-light that leads travelers off safe paths and into bogs, then feeds on the fear and despair of their drowning; wisps cluster where the most people have died lost.
tactics: Lures with its glow, winks invisible when attacked, and shocks anyone stuck in the mire.
habitat: bogs, marshes and fog-shrouded moors
weakness: Starved of fear it fades; cheerful, calm travelers are nearly immune to its lure.

powers.name: Lure Light
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Knight of the Gloaming Court
summary: A pale knight in armor grown from living blackthorn who rides out of the hollow hills on Midsummer Eve to collect debts owed to the fey, usually firstborn children.
tactics: Issues a formal challenge, duels the champion with breathtaking skill, and bewitches anyone who interferes.
habitat: the hollow hills and the edges of the Twilight Realm
weakness: Cold iron burns it, and it cannot break a sworn oath or refuse an honest challenge to single combat.

powers.name: Bewitching Gaze
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Satyr Piper
summary: A goat-legged reveler whose panpipes can set a whole village dancing until dawn, or until their hearts give out; satyrs mean no real harm, they just don't understand why the dancing ever needs to stop.
tactics: Plays a charming tune to set foes dancing, a lullaby to put guards to sleep, or a panic-song to rout a mob, then headbutts anyone who covers their ears.
habitat: wild vineyards, woodland revels and fey crossroads
weakness: Stop up your ears and the music is nothing; break the pipes and he is just a goat-man.

powers.name: Dancing Tune
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled (dancing)

alternates.name: Lullaby
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Fatigued, Exhausted, Asleep

alternates.name: Panic Song
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (fleeing in panic)

name: Fire Elemental
summary: A roaring pillar of living flame summoned from the Burning Plane, which ignites everything it touches and grows angrier with every building it sets alight.
tactics: Rushes the nearest flammable thing (or person), sets everything ablaze, and burns anyone who strikes it.
habitat: the Burning Plane, volcanoes and summoning circles
weakness: Water and cold hit it hard; it cannot cross deep water.

name: Water Elemental
summary: A churning, translucent wave that rises from the sea with fish and debris tumbling inside it; it smashes ships to kindling and drags sailors into its body to drown in plain sight of their friends.
tactics: Crashes into its foes, then engulfs one and holds them inside its body until they drown.
habitat: the Drowned Plane, seas and deep lakes
weakness: Extreme cold freezes it solid; it is slow on dry land.

powers.name: Engulf and Drown
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (drowning)

name: Earth Elemental
summary: A walking landslide of granite and loam with gemstones for eyes, which swims through solid rock as fish swim through water and surfaces beneath its target.
tactics: Moves underground, erupts beneath a foe, stomps the ground to knock everyone flat, then pounds the fallen.
habitat: the Plane of Stone, mountains and deep mines
weakness: Slow and clumsy; a foe who keeps moving and stays off the ground is hard for it to reach.

name: Air Elemental
summary: A screaming vortex of wind given hate and purpose, nearly invisible until it picks up dust, leaves and people; it hurls riders from their horses and archers from their walls.
tactics: Whirls through formations as a cyclone, flings foes off ledges, and is gone before anyone can strike back.
habitat: the Plane of Winds, high peaks and open skies
weakness: Enclosed spaces cramp it; trapped in a sealed room it loses its speed.

name: Magma Elemental
summary: A shambling hulk of crusted black rock with molten orange light pouring from every crack; where it walks stone melts into glowing pools and the air ripples with killing heat.
tactics: Sprays lava over groups, then grapples and melts whoever is left; it can tunnel through rock to cut off retreat.
habitat: volcano hearts and the border between fire and earth
weakness: Doused with water or frost, its crust hardens and it slows to a crawl.

name: Ice Elemental
summary: A jagged, slowly shifting statue of blue ice wrapped in a halo of snow; whatever it grabs becomes part of its body, frozen in place like a fly in amber.
tactics: Walls off escape routes with ice, then freezes foes solid one at a time.
habitat: the Plane of Ice, glaciers and frozen tombs
weakness: Fire melts it, and it cracks badly when struck by heavy blunt weapons.

powers.name: Hoarfrost Grip
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen solid)

name: Storm Elemental
summary: A thunderhead given a furious will: a towering column of black cloud, sheeting rain and crawling lightning that wanders the plains hurling bolts at anything taller than the grass.
tactics: Rains lightning from above, deafens clusters with thunderclaps, and hammers the ground with downbursts.
habitat: storm-wracked plains and the skies above the sea
weakness: Grounded metal draws its lightning harmlessly; a lightning rod is its worst enemy.

alternates.name: Thunderclap
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened)

name: Prince of Cinders
summary: The Sultan of the Burning Plane, a forty-foot genie-lord of white-hot brass and flame who keeps mortal kings as living candles in his palace and grants wishes only to collect the souls of those who make them.
tactics: Summons a court of fire elementals, levels the battlefield with firestorms, and saves his burning scimitar for the one who insulted him.
habitat: the City of Brass at the heart of the Burning Plane
weakness: Bound by the letter of any contract; a cleverly worded wish can trap him.

alternates.name: Wall of Fire
alternates.detail: Walls and cages of flame

alternates.name: Court of Flame
alternates.detail: Fire elementals

name: Queen of the Drowned Tide
summary: The Leviathan-Queen of the Drowned Plane, a towering shape of green-black seawater crowned with the figureheads of sunken ships; every sailor who ever died at sea is said to serve in her court.
tactics: Raises a tidal wave over the enemy, imprisons champions in whirlpools, and fills the lungs of anyone who defies her with brine.
habitat: the Drowned Plane and the deepest ocean trenches
weakness: Proud and courtly; she honors sailors who pay proper tribute and offerings, and can be shamed by a broken ancient pact.

alternates.name: Whirlpool Prison
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (drowning)

powers.name: Elemental Nature
powers.detail: Life support, cold, pressure and drowning

name: The Dreaming King Beneath
summary: The prince of the Plane of Stone, a hunched colossus of granite veined with raw gold who moves so slowly that dwarves have built cities on his back without noticing, until he stands up.
tactics: Buries armies under avalanches, knocks the ground out from under everyone, and turns anything he touches to stone.
habitat: the Plane of Stone and the roots of the oldest mountains
weakness: Ponderously slow to act; a fast and nimble foe gets many blows in before he notices.

alternates.name: Earthquake
alternates.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Vulnerable, Prone

alternates.name: Petrifying Touch
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed into stone

name: Khan of the Endless Sky
summary: The prince of the Plane of Winds, an invisible titan whose only visible form is a storm-wall of whirling dust, lightning and the screaming faces of everyone it has ever snatched up into the clouds.
tactics: Never stops moving: it hurls foes into the sky, steals the breath from spellcasters, and deafens armies with its voice.
habitat: the Plane of Winds and the jet streams above the world
weakness: Capricious and bored easily; a contest of speed or wit can distract it from any fight.

alternates.name: Voice of Thunder
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (deafened)

name: Eye Tyrant
summary: A floating, fang-mouthed orb crowned with writhing eyestalks, each eye a different spell, and one great central eye that unravels magic wherever it stares; every eye tyrant believes itself the only perfect being in creation, and hates others of its kind most of all.
tactics: Hovers out of reach in a vertical shaft, turns its antimagic eye on spellcasters, and lashes everyone else with a different ray each round.
habitat: carved vertical lairs in the deep underground
weakness: Paranoid and arrogant; its eyestalks can be severed, and its own rays fail where the antimagic eye is looking.

alternates.name: Petrification Ray
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed into stone

alternates.name: Charm Ray
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

alternates.name: Fear Ray
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (cowering in terror)

alternates.name: Enervation Ray
alternates.detail: Stamina; resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Slowing Ray
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile

name: Mindrender
summary: A robed, gray-skinned psion with a face of four writhing tentacles that stuns whole parties with a wave of psychic static, then feeds, lovingly, on the brains of the cleverest; its people dream of eclipsing the sun.
tactics: Opens with a mind blast, dominates the strongest survivor as a bodyguard, and grapples the wizard to feast.
habitat: deep underground colonies around an elder brain-pool
weakness: Physically frail; if its thralls are freed it is suddenly very alone.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated

name: Chest Mimic
summary: A hungry heap of muscle that grows a perfect treasure chest for a body, gilt hinges and all, and waits patiently in vaults for a greedy hand; its lid is a jaw and its wood is sticky as tar.
tactics: Waits to be opened, glues the hand fast, then chews; it fights to the death once it has a grip.
habitat: treasure vaults, dungeon dead-ends and abandoned inns
weakness: Strong solvents, alcohol or fire break its glue; it is slow and cannot chase.

powers.name: Adhesive Hide
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

name: Cubic Dungeon Jelly
summary: A perfect ten-foot cube of clear, quivering jelly that scours dungeon corridors clean of everything organic; it is nearly invisible, and the first sign of it is often a floating skeleton and a few coins drifting toward you at walking pace.
tactics: Glides down a corridor that it fills wall to wall, engulfs whatever cannot dodge aside, and slowly digests it.
habitat: dungeon corridors and sewers
weakness: Slow and mindless; it can be led into pits and cannot climb walls.

powers.name: Engulf
powers.detail: Resisted by Dodge; Hindered and Vulnerable, Defenseless and Immobile

name: Rustmaw
summary: A skittering, armadillo-plated insect with feathery antennae that turn steel to flaking rust at a touch; it isn't evil, just hungry, and a knight's full plate is a seven-course meal.
tactics: Makes straight for whoever carries the most metal, rusts their weapon and armor away, and eats the flakes.
habitat: mines, armories and iron-rich caverns
weakness: Distractible: toss it an iron pot and it stops to eat.

name: Gulletcrawler
summary: A segmented, many-legged eel the length of a wagon that clings to tunnel ceilings, lashing down with a beard of paralytic tentacles before dragging its stiffened prey home to be eaten alive, slowly.
tactics: Drops from the ceiling, paralyzes as many targets as possible, then carries one off and comes back for the rest.
habitat: mine shafts, cave ceilings and sewers
weakness: Bright light makes it retreat to the dark; it hates open spaces.

powers.name: Paralytic Tentacles
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Murmuring Mass
summary: A heap of melted flesh studded with dozens of eyes and toothy mouths that never stop talking, in the voices of everyone it has eaten; the babble alone can drive listeners mad.
tactics: Rolls forward babbling, turns the floor to sucking flesh-mud, spits blinding goo, and gnaws on anything stuck.
habitat: deep caverns, sewers and places where something went wrong
weakness: Deafened heroes ignore its babble; it is slow and cannot climb well.

powers.name: Maddening Babble
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Compelled, Controlled (raving)

name: Dancing Blade
summary: An enchanted longsword that floats from its weapon rack and fences on its own, guided by the memory of a technique rather than a ghost; dungeon builders hang a dozen on the walls of their treasure halls.
tactics: Rises in a silent flock when the hoard is touched and slashes from every direction, aiming for gaps in armor.
habitat: treasure halls, armories and tomb guardrooms
weakness: Dispel magic drops it clattering to the floor; it follows only its last command.

name: Living Spellbook
summary: A spellbook that read itself one too many times and woke up; it flaps through forgotten libraries like a bat, slicing intruders with razor pages and imprisoning the curious inside its illustrations.
tactics: Hovers out of reach, flips open to a hypnotic page, and traps anyone who reads it as a new illustration.
habitat: wizards' libraries and forbidden archives
weakness: Paper: fire, water and a firm grip on the cover all ruin its day.

powers.name: Hypnotic Script
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

alternates.name: Bind Into Pages
alternates.detail: Resisted by Will; Dazed, Stunned, Transformed (trapped as an illustration)

name: Gold-Hoard Swarm
summary: What adventurers took for a dragon's unguarded hoard is ten thousand gilded scarab beetles playing dead; when greedy hands start filling sacks, the whole glittering mound rises and pours down their throats.
tactics: Lies still as treasure, lures with its glitter, then buries the greedy under an avalanche of chittering coins.
habitat: dragon lairs, tomb vaults and abandoned treasuries
weakness: Fire scatters it, and anyone who refuses to touch the treasure is ignored.

alternates.name: Burying Rush
alternates.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (buried and suffocating)

powers.name: Gleaming Lure
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled (gold-lust)

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: Ten thousand beetles; shrugs off single blows

name: Basilisk
summary: An eight-legged lizard of the deep desert whose dull yellow eyes slowly turn flesh to stone; its lair is ringed with startlingly lifelike statues of people mid-scream, some with arms raised to cover their faces.
tactics: Stares down anything approaching its lair, waits for the stone to set, and only then bites.
habitat: desert caves and rocky wastes
weakness: Shown its own reflection it may petrify itself; anyone fighting blindfolded is immune to its gaze.

powers.name: Petrifying Gaze
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed into stone

name: Cockatrice
summary: An ugly rooster-lizard with bat wings and a hysterical temper whose peck slowly hardens flesh into stone; a flock of them can petrify a village of livestock in an afternoon.
tactics: Flaps, shrieks and pecks at anything that comes near its nest; it does not know when to give up.
habitat: farmland, ruins and scrubby hills
weakness: Terrified of weasels and the crowing of a rooster.

powers.name: Petrifying Peck
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed into stone

name: Chimera
summary: A lion's body with a goat's head rising from its back and a serpent for a tail, and as if that were not enough, a dragon's head that breathes fire; the heads bicker constantly, and nothing ever sneaks up on it.
tactics: Swoops to scorch a group with fire, then lands to savage the survivors with every head at once.
habitat: volcanic hills and mountain wilds
weakness: The heads argue; a distraction aimed at one can leave the others confused.

name: Manticore
summary: A man-faced lion with bat wings and a tail bristling with iron spikes that it flings like a volley of crossbow bolts; it speaks in a cultured voice and enjoys explaining how it plans to eat you.
tactics: Circles overhead flinging spike volleys, mocks its prey, and lands only to finish off the wounded.
habitat: rocky badlands and mountain eyries
weakness: Vain and talkative; it can be drawn into conversation for a crucial few rounds.

name: Griffin Warmount
summary: A griffin hatched in the eyrie-stables of a knightly order and raised alongside its rider from the egg; in full barding it dives at forty miles an hour, and it will not leave a fallen rider even to save itself.
tactics: Dives with its rider, rakes a target and climbs away; if its rider falls it stands over them and fights to the death.
habitat: eyrie-castles and mountain stables
weakness: Devoted to its rider; threatening the rider pulls it out of any plan.

name: Hippogriff
summary: Half eagle, half horse, and wholly convinced it's a horse that occasionally flies; skittish, gluttonous and loyal, hippogriffs are the farm-raised cousins of the noble griffin.
tactics: Bolts when startled and fights only when cornered or protecting a foal.
habitat: mountain meadows and stables
weakness: Skittish; a loud noise or flash of light can send it flying off.

name: Pegasus
summary: A pearl-white winged horse that answers only to riders of pure heart and can outfly a storm; legend says its hoofbeats open springs of healing water where they strike stone.
tactics: Avoids fights; if forced, it kicks and flies off with its rider rather than stand its ground.
habitat: cloud-capped mountains and sacred springs
weakness: Will not carry an evil rider, and bolts from the touch of one.

name: Unicorn
summary: A silver-maned unicorn whose spiral horn cures any poison and mends any wound, guarded jealously by the forest itself; hunters who kill one for its horn are cursed for the rest of their short lives.
tactics: Heals the innocent, charges the wicked horn-first, and vanishes into its forest when outnumbered.
habitat: enchanted forests and moonlit glades
weakness: Can be lured by the innocent; poachers have long used that against it.

name: Phoenix
summary: A blazing bird the size of a war-galley sail whose death-pyre lights the sky for a week before it hatches anew from its own ashes; its tears heal any wound, and anyone who wounds it is marked by fire forever.
tactics: Blinds foes with solar radiance, lances them with sunfire from above, and heals its allies with its tears.
habitat: sun-scorched mountaintops and desert temples
weakness: It always returns to the same pyre; destroy the nest-ashes and it cannot rise again.

alternates.name: Blinding Radiance
alternates.detail: Visual

name: Roc
summary: A bird so vast that sailors mistake its shadow for a storm cloud; rocs carry off elephants to feed their chicks and nest atop peaks littered with the bones of whales.
tactics: Dives, snatches the largest target in its talons and climbs; its wingbeats flatten everything around it.
habitat: remote peaks and island mountains
weakness: Fiercely protective of its egg; stealing it makes the roc follow you anywhere.

name: Kraken-Spawn
summary: One of the countless hatchlings of the great Kraken, already big enough to drag a fishing galley under; its tentacles end in hooked beaks, and it is clever enough to hold grudges against specific ships.
tactics: Grabs sailors off the deck with its tentacles, inks the water, and pulls its catch under.
habitat: deep ocean, sea caves and shipping lanes
weakness: Out of water it is slow and suffocating.

name: Giant Scorpion
summary: A horse-sized desert scorpion with crushing pincers and a paralytic sting, which buries itself beside oasis paths and grabs whatever comes to drink.
tactics: Bursts from the sand, grabs with its pincers, and stings the held victim until it stops moving.
habitat: deserts, oases and tomb entrances
weakness: Cold makes it sluggish; it hates fire and bright light.

powers.name: Venom Sting
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Paralyzed

name: Great Tunnel Worm
summary: A violet, ridged worm long enough to swallow a siege tower, which tunnels through bedrock like a mole through soil; when the ground begins to hum the wise run, and the unlucky find themselves inside.
tactics: Erupts beneath a group, swallows the biggest target whole, stings anything that pokes it, and dives back underground.
habitat: deep earth beneath deserts and mountains
weakness: Swallowed heroes can cut their way out of its gut, which it hates.

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (swallowed and digesting)

name: Ironback Landshark
summary: An armored, shark-finned burrowing predator that swims through soil and erupts from the ground in a spray of turf to land jaws-first on horses and their riders; farmers know it by the dorsal fin cutting furrows through their fields.
tactics: Circles underground, bursts up in a leap that lands on its prey, and bites until something stops moving.
habitat: farmland, plains and rocky hills
weakness: The soft spot under its raised crest is exposed when it leaps.

name: Cave Bear
summary: A shaggy ice-age bear the size of a hay wagon that sleeps in deep caverns and wakes ravenous; its roar shakes dust from the ceiling, and to it any cave with a campfire in it is a cave with dinner in it.
tactics: Charges the light, grabs the nearest foe in a crushing hug and mauls it.
habitat: deep caves and frozen highlands
weakness: Can be pacified with a large offering of food.

name: Dire Wolf
summary: A shaggy wolf the size of a warhorse that hunts in howling packs across the frozen north; goblin and orc tribes ride them into battle, and a dire wolf that loses its rider simply eats him.
tactics: Packs harry and trip their prey, then pile on whatever goes down.
habitat: tundra, pine forests and goblin war-camps
weakness: Fears fire; a wall of flame keeps a pack at bay.

name: Worg
summary: A wolf with a cruel, human intelligence behind its yellow eyes, speaking a snarling tongue and serving goblin kings as scout and executioner; worgs command ordinary wolves the way officers command conscripts.
tactics: Directs wolves to surround prey, taunts it in broken speech, and trips the leader first.
habitat: dark forests and goblin kingdoms
weakness: Treacherous; it will betray its goblin masters for a better offer.

name: Giant Eagle
summary: A proud, talking eagle with a twenty-foot wingspan, ally of hard-pressed heroes and enemy of goblins and wargs; giant eagles keep ancient oaths and arrive, as tradition demands, at the last possible moment.
tactics: Dives on goblins and wolves, plucks allies out of danger, and carries them away.
habitat: mountain eyries
weakness: Proud; will not serve anyone who orders rather than asks.

name: Pyrohydra
summary: A seven-headed hydra born in the crater lake of a volcano, each head breathing fire; cauterizing its stumps does nothing to a creature made of flame, and only frost stops the heads growing back two at a time.
tactics: Bathes the area in sevenfold flame, then bites everything in reach; it shrugs off wounds that would end anything else.
habitat: volcanic crater lakes and hot springs
weakness: Frost or ice applied to a severed neck stops it from regrowing.

name: Medusa
summary: A once-beautiful priestess cursed with a crown of hissing vipers and a gaze that turns living flesh to stone; she curates her victims like a gallery, posing each new statue to her own exacting taste.
tactics: Hides among her statues, shoots from shadow, and meets the eyes of anyone who closes in.
habitat: ruined temples and statue-filled island gardens
weakness: Her own reflection can petrify her; heroes who fight blindfolded or by mirror avoid the gaze.

powers.name: Petrifying Gaze
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Hindered, Immobile, Transformed into stone

name: Harpy
summary: A filthy, vulture-winged hag-bird with a voice of heartbreaking sweetness; harpies sing travelers off cliff edges and squabble over the remains like gulls.
tactics: Sings from a high perch to lure victims toward a drop, then dives to rake whoever resists.
habitat: sea cliffs, crags and ruined towers
weakness: Stopped ears make it a scavenger with a bad attitude; cowardly when hurt.

powers.name: Luring Song
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled

name: Centaur Stargazer
summary: A proud horse-bodied archer of the open steppe who reads omens in the stars and shoots with a bow taller than a man; centaur herds are wary of outsiders and quick to call a broken promise an act of war.
tactics: Shoots while galloping, never letting foes close, and runs down anyone who flees.
habitat: open steppes, plains and forest edges
weakness: Cramped spaces and stairs hamper it badly.

name: Sphinx
summary: A winged lion with the face of a serene, ageless queen, set to guard a tomb or a truth by gods long dead; it asks a riddle of everyone who would pass, and has never once been wrong about who deserved to die.
tactics: Speaks first; it fights only those who fail its riddle or force their way past, roaring them into submission and tearing them apart.
habitat: desert tombs, sacred gates and forgotten temples
weakness: Bound by its sacred charge: answer its riddle correctly and it must let you pass.

powers.name: Roar of Ages
powers.detail: Resisted by Will; Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated (cowering in terror)

name: Salamander
summary: A serpent-bodied warrior from the Burning Plane with a crest of flame, wielding a red-hot iron spear; salamanders are bound as smiths and slaves by fire giants, and they hate their masters only slightly less than they hate everyone else.
tactics: Stabs with its spear, coils around a foe to burn them, and scorches anyone who touches it.
habitat: the Burning Plane and fire-giant forges
weakness: Cold and water hurt it; it can be bargained with by promising freedom from its masters.

name: Myconid Sporelord
summary: A twelve-foot mushroom-man whose cap glows pale violet in the dark of the Underdeep; it speaks through telepathic spores, rules a silent garden-colony, and raises fallen intruders as shambling, fungus-stuffed servants.
tactics: Pacifies intruders with spores and only turns to rotting spores if attacked; fallen enemies rise again as its servants.
habitat: fungus forests deep underground
weakness: Dry heat and fire scorch its spores; it is slow and peaceful unless provoked.

powers.name: Pacifying Spores
powers.detail: Resisted by Fortitude; Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (blissful stupor)
